materials.label: Beams (6 x 6)
materials.why: Heavy timbers on the piers. The floor joists rest on them.

materials.label: Framing nails
materials.why: Hold the frame together. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Pier blocks
materials.why: Concrete blocks that keep the wood off the wet ground and carry the weight.

materials.label: Floor joists (2 x 8)
materials.why: The beams of the floor, 40 cm apart. Closer joists make a stiffer floor.

materials.label: Framing nails
materials.why: Hold the frame together. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Rim joists (2 x 8)
materials.why: The boards that close the ends of the floor joists and hold them upright.

materials.label: Screws
materials.why: Fix the sheets down. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Subfloor sheets
materials.why: Sheets across the joists. They give you a deck to stand and build on.

materials.label: Framing nails
materials.why: Hold the frame together. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Headers (2 x 6)
materials.why: The beam over a door or window. It carries the load above around the opening.

materials.label: Studs (2 x 4)
materials.why: The uprights inside your walls. They carry the roof down to the floor.

materials.label: Wall plates (2 x 4)
materials.why: The boards along the bottom and top of each wall. The studs are nailed between them.

materials.label: Framing nails
materials.why: Hold the frame together. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Wall plates (2 x 4)
materials.why: The boards along the bottom and top of each wall. The studs are nailed between them.

materials.label: Framing nails
materials.why: Hold the frame together. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Gable studs (2 x 4)
materials.why: Short uprights that fill the triangle under the roof at each end.

materials.label: Rafters (2 x 6)
materials.why: The sloping beams of the roof. They carry rain and snow out to the walls.

materials.label: Roof sheets
materials.why: Sheets on the rafters. They make the roof one stiff surface for the roofing.

materials.label: Screws
materials.why: Fix the sheets down. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Roof underlayment
materials.why: A waterproof layer under the roofing, the second line of defence against leaks.
materials.missing: roofing underlayment by the square metre

materials.label: Roofing
materials.why: The outer skin of the roof. It keeps the water out.

materials.label: Screws
materials.why: Fix the sheets down. Bought by weight and used up as you build.

materials.label: Wall sheathing
materials.why: Sheets nailed to the outside of the studs. They stop the frame leaning over in wind.

materials.label: Housewrap
materials.why: Keeps wind and rain out of the wall while letting damp escape.

materials.label: Doors
materials.why: A way in that closes. Without it the room is not enclosed.

materials.label: Window glass
materials.why: Lets light in while keeping the weather out.

materials.label: Siding boards
materials.why: The boards on the outside. They protect the wall from weather and sun.

materials.label: Flooring
materials.why: The finished floor you walk on.
